evidence: Ma–Garnett–Schneider 2012 gives a 1−1/e bound for **true trace-marginal greedy**; its guarantee neither forces diagonal-greedy optimality on small graphs nor excludes five-node failure.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A strict counterexample on an arbitrary PSD input does not imply the unique five-node diamond-with-leaf obstruction for Green kernels; conversely this narrow finite theorem does not generalize the prior worst-case rates. The new contribution is the sharp size cutoff, complete class enumeration and exact pair regret.
